column1: # FMA ↔ UBERON bridge — GENERATED, do not edit by hand.
# Every row comes from UBERON's OWN published cross-references, read from the
# EBI OLS4 API — the same route the MOOSE and TCIA crosswalks in this directory
# were built by. Nothing here is hand-authored: this project has no standing to
# assert an equivalence between two vocabularies it does not maintain.
# ⚠️ AN XREF IS NOT PROOF OF EXACT EQUIVALENCE. `confidence` is `ambiguous` where
# UBERON lists MORE THAN ONE FMA term for the same concept, which is a one-to-many
# correspondence rather than an identity. Do not collapse those to the first id —
# a wrong ontology id hides the wrong structure, which is worse than hiding none.
# `in_repo` is the subset of `fma` that some asset or crosswalk here actually uses.
# An empty `in_repo` is a valid bridge to anatomy this repository does not hold.
# 153 UBERON ids queried, 143 carry an FMA xref, 89 join to geometry here.
# `via` is how the join was made. `direct` means UBERON's own xref id is used
# by an asset here. `fma-child` means it is not, and the ids in `in_repo` are the
# SIDED FMA terms found by descending FMA's is_a hierarchy from that xref —
# `tibia` FMA:24476 has children FMA:24477 right and FMA:24478 left, which is what
# the atlases actually use. Both are authoritative; neither is a name match.
